about: Ground plan for the main-pool area (docs/SMOOTH_PATHS.md, drawn by src/ground-plan.ts, checked by scripts/check_ground_plan.py). Paths are centrelines with a width; patios, aprons and green spaces are outlines. Each surface has a finish, evidence and what bounds it (edges). World metres: x east, z south, the frame of public/map/skeleton.json. The traced points are the data; the drawing smooths them.
trust: November ground photos of the big-pool lawn and the steps to Enrique's. Lines are estimated from the camera pins and headings, good to about 4 m; widths and heights are read by eye. The glass fence those photos show is left out (Dave, 2026-10-11, confirmed 2026-11-12).

surfaces.name: Pink resin paths across the main-pool lawn
surfaces.note: 2026-11-13, against the georeferenced aerial (public/map/ground.jpg, Esri): the main path is the 2.5 m brown strip running straight from the gate to the pool's south-west corner, with the narrower planted strip, loungers and palms on its left by the Guillermo wall and the big lawn on its right, as IMG_2764, IMG_2765 and IMG_2603 show; the model's line ran 5-6 m further east through the middle of the lawn and is moved onto the strip (read to about 1 m on the aerial, whose registration is good to 1-2 m). IMG_2764 shows the branch to the shower and hedge leaving at the camera's feet, and IMG_2603 a second branch forking left about 2 m ahead towards the white wall runs (IMG_2763 stands on it); its far end is estimated and stops short of the strelitzia corner.

surfaces.name: Inner tiled path from the foot of Calle Guillermo to the beach gate
surfaces.note: IMG_2600 and IMG_2601, from the foot of Calle Guillermo, show a tiled path running down east-south-east between lavender and a white wall to a lawn strip, a hedge and the mesh fence; IMG_2763 shows flagstones curving between the hedge and the round white wall, and IMG_2602 the flagstones running on to the gate. It joins the lane's end to the apron inside the boundary (Dave, 2026-11-13: the only way out is the gate). Line by eye between the round wall and the fence, about 1.6 m wide.

edges.note: IMG_2600 shows lavender in a bed edged by a low white wall along the kiosk side of the path, and IMG_2601 a white planter with lavender further down; height by eye, and which stretch each bed covers is estimated (photo request guillermo-foot-closure).

surfaces.name: Flagstone apron in front of the lawn's arched gate
surfaces.note: Redrawn 2026-11-12 inland of the gateway: the earlier ring straddled the wall line. Extent by eye from IMG_2759 and IMG_2602.
